question: Business Requirements Description for the Educational Management System: A school plans to develop an educational management system aimed at integrating course management, student management, user management, system settings, and tool asset management. The course management module shall record Course ID, teacher, class hours, description, and schedule to support course inquiries and arrangements. The student management module shall record Student ID, name, grade, and class, facilitating the management and communication of student information. The course enrollment module shall record Student ID and Course ID for managing course selections by students. The user management module is responsible for maintaining User ID, email, password, and username, ensuring system security. The system settings module shall store system name, theme, page configuration, and version information for system configuration adjustments. The tool management module shall record the name, asset number, and holder, and manage tool loan records, including Record ID, borrower, asset number, and time, to optimize asset management.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0217
CREATE TABLE `courses` (
  `course_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `teacher` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `class_hours` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `schedule` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`course_id`),
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `student_class` (
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `class` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`, `class`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `students` (`student_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `students` (
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `grade` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`),
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `course_enrollments` (
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `course_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`, `course_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `students` (`student_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`course_id`) REFERENCES `courses` (`course_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `system_settings` (
  `system_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `theme` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `page_configuration` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `version` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`system_name`),
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tool_assets` (
  `asset_number` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `holder` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`asset_number`),
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tool_loans` (
  `record_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `borrower` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `asset_number` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `time` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`record_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`asset_number`) REFERENCES `tool_assets` (`asset_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`),
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
